_comment: B40 measurement fixture. 2000 text deltas, ZERO delay -- the point is that wall-clock is dominated by the emit path rather than by the provider. mock_slow.json cannot measure the event-log write: it is 20 chunks at delay 0.3, so six seconds of asyncio.sleep swamps any per-write cost and both arms of the comparison report ~6.0s. This fixture is the discriminating arm; mock_slow stays as the realistic-cadence arm.
